page_title: Mortgage & Loan Calculator — Payments, Charts & Amortization | Pratix.io
meta_description: Calculate mortgage, personal loan and auto loan payments with charts, amortization schedule, CSV export and print/PDF output. Private browser-based calculator with 12 language support.
hero_desc: Estimate monthly payments, total interest, repayment schedule and loan balance charts before making borrowing decisions.
info_body: The calculator uses a standard amortization formula. Extra monthly payments are applied directly to the remaining balance after scheduled interest is calculated.
privacy_body: All calculations run in your browser. Your loan amount, interest rate and schedule are not sent to Pratix.io servers.
legal_body: This tool is for general informational and estimation purposes only. It is not financial, legal, tax or investment advice and does not replace an official bank, lender, broker or professional quote. Actual payments may vary due to fees, taxes, insurance, compounding rules, exchange rates, lender policies, regulatory changes and your individual credit profile. You are responsible for verifying all results with a qualified professional or financial institution before making decisions. Pratix.io is not liable for decisions, losses or damages arising from the use of this calculator.
error_term: Term must be between 1 and 50 years.
error_down: Down payment cannot be greater than loan amount.
error_payment_low: Payment is not enough to reduce the balance. Adjust amount, term, rate or extra payment.
error_generic: Calculation failed. Please check the inputs.
no_results: Calculate first to create export data.
footer_note: Estimates only. Verify with your lender before making financial decisions.
